Please get the motorcycle checked through an Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre to identify and correct the reason for not starting.

server_required_source_display.text: Do not keep holding the starter for long periods: this can drain the battery below 10 V. An unresolved no-start condition requires authorised-service inspection.

source_spans.exact_text:  To shift into neutral, move the motorcycle back and forth gently, while simultaneously shifting the gear. Ensure gear is in neutral position and the neutral lamp is glowing in the instrument cluster.
 Turn ignition key to ON position and engine kill switch on right hand side handle bar to run position.
 Check the fuel level indicator in the cluster for adequate fuel in the fuel tank. In case the last bar is blinking continuously, it indicates low fuel level in the tank. Please re-fuel immediately.
 Disengage clutch by pulling in the clutch lever and hold it in depressed condition.

 Vehicle may start with side stand condition but engine will turn-off when gear is engaged, this side stand cutoff feature is provided for rider safety ensure side stand is retracted before vehicle moving / starting.
